categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: the 'Buydeem' proprietary brand business and OEM/ODM services. The Buydeem brand focuses on high-quality kitchen small appliances and related products such as health pots, water dispensers, ovens, steamers, air fryers, enamel cast iron pots, tableware, and beverages, along with user services like cooking communities and expert guidance. The OEM/ODM segment provides integrated R&D, design, and manufacturing services for well-known global brands in high-end lifestyle appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes product design and innovation with a structured four-stage development process: insight, validation, creation, and manufacturing. It employs lean production principles with an 'order plus safety stock' model, primarily self-manufacturing kitchen small appliances supplemented by OEM production. Advanced automation, ERP systems (SAP), and quality control systems including ISO9001:2015 and Six Sigma are used to ensure product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international consumers purchasing the Buydeem brand products, as well as global well-known brands served through OEM/ODM contracts. The company targets consumers seeking improved dietary lifestyles and high-quality kitchen appliances. Major markets include China (domestic sales) and overseas regions such as North America, Europe, Japan, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with extensive domestic sales and distribution networks, including online and offline channels. It has expanded its proprietary brand presence internationally through e-commerce platforms like Amazon and direct sales in North America, Europe, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Subsidiaries and branches are established in multiple Chinese cities and overseas locations including Germany, Korea, the USA, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It undertakes product R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales, including direct-to-consumer sales and OEM/ODM manufacturing for other brands. It controls production and quality assurance, sourcing raw materials and components from suppliers but focusing on finished product delivery and brand management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company prioritizes expanding its product portfolio with high-quality, aesthetically pleasing, and user-friendly kitchen appliances to meet diverse consumer needs. It invests significantly in R&D (about 5.14% of revenue in 2024) to innovate and optimize products and production processes. The company also focuses on global brand expansion, enhancing user experience, multi-channel marketing, and operational efficiency through digital transformation and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of the Buydeem proprietary brand and OEM/ODM manufacturing services. Sales channels include direct online sales via company-owned platforms and third-party e-commerce sites, offline retail stores, and wholesale distribution. The company also earns from related services such as user communities and after-sales support. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a high-quality, innovative lifestyle brand in the kitchen small appliance industry with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities. It competes by offering differentiated products with superior design, quality, and user experience, supported by a robust brand reputation and global market presence. The company leverages its OEM/ODM expertise to maintain stable growth and industry relevance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 753.6 million, a 13.28% increase over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 69.5 million. The company has shown steady revenue growth, especially in overseas markets (36.15% growth) and OEM/ODM business (21.99% growth). Total assets were around RMB 978 million, with a slight increase from the prior year. The company maintains a moderate net profit margin and continues investing in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering products that combine excellent aesthetics, functionality, and quality to improve consumers' dietary lifestyles. It differentiates through deep user insight, innovative design, and high manufacturing standards, supported by multiple international design awards. The brand offers comprehensive user services and a responsible, warm customer experience. Its global expansion and multi-channel engagement further enhance its competitive edge.
